documents.title: Approval For Raising Of Funds For An Aggregate Amount Of Up To And Not Exceeding ? 1,800 Crores Through One Or More Public Or Private Offering Including A Qualified Institutions Placement ('QIP') Of Equity Shares Or Other Eligible Securities To Eligible Investors.
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of EGM
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Management stated that Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue reached INR2,391 crores, up 61% year-on-year, with a reported PAT of INR129 crores. The company reported a gross margin of 9.6% and highlighted growth in the advance gold model and studded jewelry segment. Management also discussed improvements in working capital days, operating cash flow generation, and expanding export contributions alongside strategic integration of past acquisitions. Sky Gold & Diamonds Limited reported its financial and operational performance for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, highlighting strong growth in revenue, EBITDA, and PAT. Management emphasized strategic acquisitions, expanding international presence, and enhanced corporate governance frameworks including new auditor appointments.

guidance.claim: The company maintains its current FY27 revenue target of INR8,100 crores.
guidance.quote: Our current FY27 revenue target of INR8,100 crores is meaningfully higher than the outlook we had communicated 9 months ago.

guidance.claim: Management targets revenue of INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.
guidance.quote: We remain firmly on track to achieve our aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27 and INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.

demand_outlook.claim: The company observes a karatage shift from 22-karat to 18-karat, 14-karat, and 9-karat.
demand_outlook.quote: Every quarter, we are seeing that there's a drastic change in the karatage shift from 22-karat shifting to 18-karat, 18-karat shifting to 14-karat and 9-karat.

demand_outlook.claim: Participation in the Asiana U.K. India Jewellery Expo resulted in a prospective order pipeline of approximately INR30 crores to INR45 crores.
demand_outlook.quote: The response was highly encouraging, resulting in strong initial interest and helping us to build a prospective order pipeline of approximately INR30 crores to INR45 crores across the U.K. and European markets.

capex_expansion.claim: Future facility expansion is expected to require INR80 crores to INR100 crores of capex post-2028 under a leased model.
capex_expansion.quote: It will be close to INR80 crores to INR100 crores, which will be just 20% to 25% of the PAT that we will generate at that point of time, since we have already built a world-class facility and we have already invested in the capacity and infrastructure.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated gross profit for Q2 FY27 was INR229 crores, representing an 87% increase.
margins_costs.quote: Gross profit was INR229 crores, up 87%.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by 133 basis points to 9.6% compared to Q2 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded 133 basis points to 9.6% versus Q2 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q2 FY27 was INR189.8 crores with a 7.9% margin.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA was INR189.8 crores at a 7.9% margin, up 90%.

margins_costs.claim: Reported PAT for Q2 FY27 reached INR129 crores, up 93% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: Reported PAT was INR129 crores, up 93%.

margins_costs.claim: Operational PAT excluding exceptional items was INR135 crores, reflecting a 5.6% margin.
margins_costs.quote: Excluding it, operational PAT was INR135 crore, a 5.6% margin, up 101% year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: Operating costs rose to 1.6% of sales due to investments in personnel.
margins_costs.quote: Operating costs rose to 1.6% of sales, as we invested in people: a CEO, a larger design team, and stronger audit and finance functions.

margins_costs.claim: Value-added share of business has increased in the recent period serving as the primary driver for gross margin expansion.
margins_costs.quote: Margin Expansion: Reflecting our strengthening merchandising capabilities, our Value-Added share of business has increased in the recent period serving as the primary driver for gross margin expansion.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated gross margin increased to 9.3% in Q1 FY27 compared to 9.1% in Q4 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Our consolidated gross margin increased to 9.3% in Q1 FY27 versus 9.1% in Q4 FY26, an improvement of 27 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: The share of non-22 KT jewelry increased from 10.5% in Q4 FY26 to 14% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: First, the share of non-22 KT jewelry has increased from 10.5%in Q4FY26 to 14% in Q1 FY27 due to structural shift in customer preference towards lower Karatage jewelry.

margins_costs.claim: The share of studded jewelry increased from 1.65% in Q4 FY26 to 2.1% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: The share of studded jewelry has also increased from 1.65% in Q4 '26 to 2.1% in Q1 '27, on account of management's focus on better-margin products.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA increased to INR157 crores, representing 7.8% for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased to INR157 crores, to 7.8% for the quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: Exports reached INR435 crores in Q2 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: In Q2 FY27, we have reached exports of INR435 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: The merchandising team successfully onboarded one of the Middle East's largest retail chains in record time.
orders_capacity.quote: Our merchandising team successfully onboarded one of the Middle East’s largest retail chains in record time—a feat notable because the typical sales cycle for such clients is considerably longer.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization stands at approximately 55% to 57% / 60%.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, the capacity utilization is close to 55%- 57%.
So, 1.2 tons is our capacity to produce, and we are 60% approx utilization in the last quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: H1 operating cash flow was INR136 crores compared to an outflow in the previous year.
capital_allocation.quote: H1 operating cash flow was INR136 crores, against the outflow of INR100.9 crores in H1 last year.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated approximately INR30 crores of operating cash flow during the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: I am pleased to report that during quarter, the company has generated approximately INR30 crores of operating cash flow, marking an important milestone in our journey towards building a stronger and more self- sufficient business model.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt level for the quarter stands at INR540 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Net debt level for this quarter is INR540 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Beginning FY27, the company will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model.
capital_allocation.quote: Beginning FY27, we will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model.

risks_headwinds.claim: An exceptional charge of INR7.35 crores was recorded for a fraud incident at subsidiary Star Mangalsutra.
risks_headwinds.quote: This is after an exceptional charge of INR7.35 crores for the fraud incident at our subsidiary, Star Mangalsutra, disclosed in July.

risks_headwinds.claim: Heightened volatility in gold prices has created margin pressures across various retailers and manufacturers within the jewelry industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: In recent quarters, heightened volatility in gold prices has created margin pressures across various retailers and manufacturers within the jewelry industry.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters will only take salary when there are operating cash flows.
management_commitments.quote: Promoters will only take salary when there is operating cash flows.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, and all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.
management_commitments.quote: In line with our cash-first philosophy and uncompromising governance standards, promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains on track to achieve its aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27 and INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.
management_commitments.quote: We remain firmly on track to achieve our aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27 and INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.

management_commitments.claim: Beginning FY27, the company will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model.
management_commitments.quote: Beginning FY27, we will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets to reach 52 days working capital by 2030 under Sky Gold Vision 2030.
management_commitments.quote: with an overall target to reach 52 days by 2030 in the Sky Gold Vision 2030 that we are looking at.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
